name: Elkin Joao López Garcés
title: Software Engineering Student
summary: Software Engineering student with academic and collaborative work across web interfaces, backend services, databases and applied AI. Professional internship experience with Angular, C# and Oracle at AMBACAR.

experience.summary: Contributed to AMBYSOFT business applications and supported technology operations across AMBACAR agencies.

responsibilities.title: Requirements & application design
responsibilities.text: Configured the development environment, analyzed requirements, reviewed the architecture and contributed to the functional design of the ZEUS user administration module in AMBYSOFT.

responsibilities.title: Frontend development
responsibilities.text: Designed, developed and optimized Angular interfaces for Workshop Employee, Roles, ZEUS Menu and Seller workflows in the Reverse Flow module.

responsibilities.title: Backend & data integration
responsibilities.text: Analyzed the Oracle database, developed backend functionality in C# and integrated services with the frontend of the Reverse Flow module.

responsibilities.title: Testing & maintenance
responsibilities.text: Executed functional and integration tests, refactored code, corrected issues and applied technical adjustments to the developed functionality.

responsibilities.title: Technology operations
responsibilities.text: Provided technical support, preventive maintenance, equipment checks and technology asset inventory updates across AMBACAR agencies.

experience.reflection: The internship introduced me to professional development workflows, new technologies and the day-to-day work of a business technology team.
